hero.intro2: We’re getting married and throwing a massive party! Woo-hoo! We invite you to spend a jolly weekend with us – enjoying good food & drinks, celebrating, chatting, playing and dancing. The party will take place in the heart of the Swabian Alb at the Alb Schlosshof. A lovely spot, surrounded by woods and meadows, that invites to linger. We're looking forward to celebrating with you.

footer.line1: We're looking forward to seeing you!
